build_dataloader_images: build a dataloader for images in a directory with configurable batch size and transforms
create_image_folder_dataset: create an image folder dataset for self-supervised learning with optional transforms
create_coco_segmentation_dataloader: create a COCO segmentation dataloader with multi-mask support and distributed training
build_coco_mask_loader: build a COCO mask loader that supports single combined mask or multi-object mask modes
run_custom_collate_masks: run custom collate function that pads variable-length mask tensors to uniform batch size
